name: From Plot to Plate: the Dunshire Egg objective tracks the egg nests, not the innkeeper (#11956)
contract: Quest 175030 From Plot to Plate requires 559863 Windswept Sheep Milk x3, 559864 Windswept Cow Milk x5 and 559865 Dunshire Egg x7. The eggs loot from the 8 Dunshire Eggs gameobjects 2300642 (guids 9920415-9920422) around (-7816, 545, 136.36). The client's QuestSuperTrack.dbc row 32929 has only objective 0 node 9177 at Innkeeper Miralda (-7772.03, 601.39, 138.28) and turn-in node 9114 at Hestwin Honeycrust, so the egg objective falls back to the innkeeper, about 71 yd from the nests.

Expected: row 32929 is streamed whole with the client's nodes 9177 (objective 0) and 9114 (turn-in), plus objective 2 node 21064 on Dunshire Eggs guid 9920422 (-7815.85, 545.566, 136.357) with the row's own 4 yd radius; nodes 9177 and 9114 stay unpatched.
These are data assertions on the bytes the server sends; the harness cannot see how the client draws the diamond.
